result.summary: Found 1 issue: a loading spinner is stuck over the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image even though the photo is fully rendered.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is overlaid in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card image, obscuring the food photo, even though the image behind it appears fully loaded.
issues.suggestion: Remove the loading overlay once the image has finished loading, and only show the spinner while the image is actually loading.
